long_biography.plain_text:
Ciner began working in tea shops while still at school and entered trade through automotive parts and imported cars. He founded the business that became Ciner Group in 1978, then moved through textiles, airport services, mining, power generation and broadcasting. Industrial minerals ultimately supplied the strongest wealth engine, led by large-scale natural soda ash production.

Today the group is organised around energy and mining, glass and chemicals, and maritime operations. Its London-based WE Soda business is controlled by Ciner and expanded in 2025 with the acquisition of Genesis Alkali in the United States. The group sold its television and digital-media interests after a 22-year run, removing media from the current portfolio. Production plants, shipping assets and other operating property belong to group companies rather than to Ciner personally.
